profile.headline: Founding Engineer @Medlaunch Concepts | Backend Engineer building HIPAA-compliant HealthTech platforms | Node · AWS · Python | Virginia Tech Alum
profile.geoLocationName: East Meadow, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I build secure, scalable backend systems where getting it wrong isn't an option.
 
Currently Lead Backend Engineer at Medlaunch Concepts, a HealthTech startup building the next generation of healthcare accreditation software. I own the full backend architecture: HIPAA-compliant document processing APIs, AWS ECS microservices with Docker, CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, and MongoDB data models handling sensitive accreditation workflows.
 
Before this, I spent 2+ years at Experion Technologies building production healthcare and pharma software — including a medicine ordering portal (QuVa) that improved system reliability by 30% and cut API latency by 75%, and a Janssen POC that reduced integration time by 40%.
 
What I do best: 
→ Design and ship secure RESTful APIs under compliance constraints 
→ Deploy and manage AWS infrastructure (ECS, ECR, SQS, Lambda, EC2) 
→ Lead backend teams and mentor junior engineers in startup environments 
→ Move fast without breaking things — CI/CD, code reviews, stress testing included
 
I hold an MEng in Computer Science from Virginia Tech (2024–2025), where I focused on NLP, cloud computing, ML, and information security.
 
Open to senior backend/full-stack/software engineering roles in HealthTech, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise SaaS.

positions.title: Lead Backend Developer
positions.description:
As the Lead Backend Developer at Medlaunch Concepts, I am driving the architecture and development of secure, scalable backend systems that power a next-generation platform for healthcare accreditation. My work ensures the integration of security best practices into the development and deployment lifecycle, ensuring our backend services are compliant, resilient, and production-ready.

Key Responsibilities:
Designing and implementing secure RESTful APIs to support critical features such as user authentication and authorization, document management workflows, using modern backend frameworks like Node and Express. Supporting 3+ core product workflows including auth, document management, and analytics.

Developing and maintaining MongoDB data models and schemas to handle complex accreditation data efficiently while ensuring data integrity, security, and performance. Handling accreditation data for healthcare institutions with zero reported data integrity failures.

Creating backend services for HIPAA-compliant document processing, including AI-driven document extraction, classification, and secure storage.

Managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to streamline testing, integration, and production deployments. Reducing deployment friction and enabling same-day hotfix releases.

Deploying microservices on AWS ECS, using Docker containers and Amazon ECR for a secure, scalable deployment infrastructure. Achieving consistent uptime for a production HealthTech platform.

Implementing robust security protocols, including data encryption, role-based access controls, and regular security audits to maintain regulatory compliance.

Leading backend code reviews and mentoring junior developers, promoting best practices, and maintaining high code quality across the team. Mentored 4+ co-op engineers who each shipped full features to production.

Handling additional technical responsibilities as needed, including performance tuning, stress testing, and incident response planning.
positions.insights: Database Management System (DBMS), Back-End Web Development and +12 skills

positions.title: Event Assistant at Executive Briefing Center
positions.description:
As an Event Assistant at the Executive Briefing Center (EBC) in Arlington, VA, I play a pivotal role in managing event operations, especially for high-profile clients, including Fortune 500 C-suite executives, government stakeholders, and Virginia Tech’s programs. My work emphasizes troubleshooting AV equipment, ensuring seamless event experiences, and providing exceptional customer support. Key responsibilities include:

• Providing tailored AV support and technical assistance, ensuring smooth operation of equipment and online meeting platforms during events.
• Led event setup, including meeting room arrangements, AV troubleshooting, and catering coordination, ensuring high-quality service for all events.
• Utilizing event management software (EMS) to manage event logistics, from gathering event details to preparing setup requirements and facilitating seamless execution.
• Managing front desk reception when needed, serving as the initial point of contact for clients, and addressing inquiries or concerns promptly.
• Ensuring safety protocols, maintaining conference areas, and supporting client needs in real-time to enhance overall event quality.
• Delivering personalized service to high-profile clients, showcasing strong leadership, problem-solving, and effective communication under dynamic conditions.

This position has strengthened my leadership and customer support communication skills, especially in high-pressure situations. I excel at quickly adapting to event changes while maintaining professionalism and attention to detail.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: At Experion Technologies, I contributed to the full-stack development of several high-impact projects. I developed and maintained a production-level medicine ordering portal, QuVa, using Angular and .NET frameworks. My role involved designing new features, improving system reliability by 30%, and optimizing REST APIs, which reduced data-fetching time by 75%. I led the development of a Proof-of-Concept (POC) for the Janssen healthcare project using Python, cutting integration time by 40%. Additionally, I contributed to a web app, Spectrum, where my work on database normalization and backend development using Node.js and Sequelize improved resource allocation efficiency by 20%. These efforts consistently delivered measurable results, improved system performance, and exceeded client expectations under tight deadlines.
positions.insights: .NET Framework, Database Management System (DBMS) and +18 skills

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: As an Associate Software Engineer at Experion Technologies, I contributed to production-level full-stack development on healthcare and enterprise client projects. I worked on building and optimizing RESTful APIs, collaborated with senior engineers on Angular and Node.js-based applications, and developed strong foundations in clean code, agile workflows, and database management using MySQL and PostgreSQL. This role laid the groundwork for my promotion to Software Engineer.
positions.insights: Database Management System (DBMS), Node.js and +19 skills

projects.title: Sentiment Analysis Using Different Vectorization Methods
projects.description:
📊 Project Overview: In this project, I worked with a large dataset of social media posts to analyze sentiments expressed in the text. The goal was to classify posts as positive, negative, or neutral based on the underlying sentiment. What made this project interesting was comparing the performance of models when using various vectorization methods to represent the text.

GitHub Repo Link --> https://github.com/jobzz-kj/Twitter-Sentiment-Analysis-NLP-Pipeline
